ios.desc:
Localhost Master lets you share files and text across all your devices instantly — no internet, no cloud, no cables required. Just connect to the same Wi-Fi and you're ready to go.

Simply add a file or type some text, and Localhost Master spins up a local HTTP server on your device. Every item gets a unique 4-digit code. Anyone on your network can access it instantly from a phone, tablet, PC, smart TV, or any browser — just by visiting a simple URL.

Key Features:

Multi-Device Support
Share with smart TVs, Windows PCs, Macs, iPhones, iPads, phones, and any device with a browser — all on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot.

Local Network Only
Everything stays on your network. Your files never touch the internet or any external server. Fast, private, and secure by design.

4-Digit Access Codes
Each shared item gets a short, memorable code. No long URLs, no account logins, no friction.

Share Files, Photos & Text
Transfer images, videos, documents, audio files, and plain text snippets in seconds.

QR Code Sharing
Generate a QR code for any item so nearby devices can connect instantly without typing anything.

Web File Manager
Upload files directly to your device from any browser on your network — no app install needed on the other end.

Folder Organization
Keep your shared items tidy with folders and custom names.

Custom Server Port
Run the server on any port you choose.

No Internet Required
All transfers happen entirely over your local network. Private, fast, and always available as long as you're on Wi-Fi.

Privacy Policy: https://mydishview.com/easy-share-privacy.html
